caseName: San Diego Gas & Elec. Co. v. Cal. Pub. Utilities Comm'n
caseNameFull: SAN DIEGO GAS & ELECTRIC COMPANY v. CALIFORNIA PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION.

opinions.text: Motion of Southern California Edison Company for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of Edison Electric Institute for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of Shareholders in California Investor-Owned Utilities for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Court of Appeal of California, Fourth Appellate District, Division One denied.
